suppress.notes:
Reviewed 2026-08-09. NVD reports a fix in Tomcat 11.0.25, but Maven Central does not currently expose the required embedded Tomcat artifacts. The NVD policy check probes core, EL and WebSocket before allowing this temporary exception to remain.
Removal condition: - remove this suppression and upgrade embedded Tomcat as soon as 11.0.25 is fetchable, or - remove/review it immediately if Apache broadens the affected scope.
CI runs Dependency-Check with failBuildOnUnusedSuppressionRule=true. The exact artifact list in the NVD policy and this explicit expiry are independent fail-closed controls.
